body.intent: Fix The Inbox app's question items aren't actionable: a row shows the question's handle or short title (e.g. 'review-01m6pf30-r3-f1', 'Claude Code Design') instead of what is asked, so the owner cannot tell what to answer. Seen 2026-11-05 on the web UI milestone's gate (run 01M6PF30, questions review-01m6pf30-r3-f1 and claude-design-output). Each question row should show the question's full statement (wrapped), its change set title, and what it blocks; the answer form should show the full statement above the text box. Also, questions raised for the owner (plan-review findings carried to the gate, leaf-failed questions) should be written for the owner in plain language with the agent's recommendation, not as an engineering finding: the review finding about Operation.Write had to be re-explained in chat before the owner could decide.
